Options: `added` (a resource was created), `changed` (a resource was modified), `removed` (a resource was detached from a parent), `deleted` (a resource was deleted), `undeleted` (a deletion was undone). Selected actions become the webhook's `filters` so Asana only delivers matching events, and are re-checked on each inbound delivery.
